slug: 2026-03-16 Chad uses national biometric registry to boost govt systems interoperability

facts.fact: Chad is implementing the Tchad Connexion 2030 strategy, whose period runs to 2030, with targets of at least 80 percent national internet coverage and about 80 percent mobile penetration and around US$1.5bn of ICT investment; the date is the document's published date, 2026-03-16.
